#!/usr/bin/env bash
# tswap install script — generated by: tswap installscript
# Review this script, then run: bash installTswap.sh

set -euo pipefail

BINARY="/tmp/tswap-download/tswap"

# Temporary files of this run, removed however it ends. BROKER_PENDING is set between updating the
# tswap-broker SELinux module and replacing the broker's labelled copy, which must match.
CLEANUP=()
BROKER_PENDING=""
on_exit() {
  local status=$? p
  for p in "${CLEANUP[@]+"${CLEANUP[@]}"}"; do
    [ -e "$p" ] || continue
    rm -rf "$p" 2>/dev/null || sudo rm -rf "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
  done
  if [ -n "$BROKER_PENDING" ] && [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "!!  Stopped after updating the tswap-broker module but before its labelled copy; they must match. Run this script again." >&2
  fi
}
trap on_exit EXIT

# install_binary SRC DEST [sudo]: copies next to DEST, then renames over it. A running tswap (an unlock
# agent, a broker) keeps its old file and the new one appears at once; never an in-place overwrite, which
# on macOS rewrites the pages of a running signed binary.
install_binary() {
  local src="$1" dest="$2" run="${3:-}" tmp
  $run mkdir -p "$(dirname "$dest")"
  tmp="$($run mktemp "$dest.new.XXXXXX")"
  CLEANUP+=("$tmp")
  $run cp -f "$src" "$tmp"
  $run chmod 0755 "$tmp"
  $run mv -f "$tmp" "$dest"
}

echo "==> Installing tswap binary..."
install_binary "$BINARY" /usr/local/bin/tswap sudo
echo "    Installed to /usr/local/bin/tswap"

echo "==> Installing Secure Enclave support library..."
DYLIB_TMP="$(mktemp)"
CLEANUP+=("$DYLIB_TMP")
echo "AQIDBAU=" | base64 -D > "$DYLIB_TMP"
install_binary "$DYLIB_TMP" /usr/local/bin/libtswapse.dylib sudo
echo "    Installed to /usr/local/bin/libtswapse.dylib"

echo "==> Installing tswap skill (SKILL.md)..."
mkdir -p "$HOME/.agents/skills/tswap"
/usr/local/bin/tswap prompt > "$HOME/.agents/skills/tswap/SKILL.md"
echo "    Written to ~/.agents/skills/tswap/SKILL.md"

echo "==> Creating Claude Code symlink..."
mkdir -p "$HOME/.claude/skills"
[ -e "$HOME/.claude/skills/tswap" ] && ! [ -L "$HOME/.claude/skills/tswap" ] && rm -rf "$HOME/.claude/skills/tswap"
ln -sfn "$HOME/.agents/skills/tswap" "$HOME/.claude/skills/tswap"
echo "    Created ~/.claude/skills/tswap -> ~/.agents/skills/tswap"

echo "==> Installing shell completions..."
# bash: auto-loaded by bash-completion from the user data dir (no rc edit needed).
BASH_COMP_DIR="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/bash-completion/completions"
mkdir -p "$BASH_COMP_DIR"
/usr/local/bin/tswap completion bash > "$BASH_COMP_DIR/tswap"
echo "    bash -> $BASH_COMP_DIR/tswap"
# fish: auto-loaded from the completions dir when fish is installed.
if command -v fish >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  FISH_COMP_DIR="$HOME/.config/fish/completions"
  mkdir -p "$FISH_COMP_DIR"
  /usr/local/bin/tswap completion fish > "$FISH_COMP_DIR/tswap.fish"
  echo "    fish -> $FISH_COMP_DIR/tswap.fish"
fi
# zsh: write the completion function; the dir must be on fpath (printed below).
# macOS ships zsh as the default shell, so this is the common path here.
if command -v zsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ZSH_COMP_DIR="$HOME/.zsh/completions"
  mkdir -p "$ZSH_COMP_DIR"
  /usr/local/bin/tswap completion zsh > "$ZSH_COMP_DIR/_tswap"
  echo "    zsh  -> $ZSH_COMP_DIR/_tswap"
  echo "         (if zsh completion doesn't load, add to ~/.zshrc: fpath+=$ZSH_COMP_DIR; autoload -Uz compinit; compinit)"
fi
echo "    Restart your shell to enable completion."

if pgrep -u "$(id -u)" -f 'tswap[^ ]* agent serve' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "    A tswap unlock agent is running and still runs the old version until you run:"
  echo "      tswap agent stop     (then unlock again)"
fi

echo ""
echo "✅ tswap installed successfully."
